locations.note: Zoë Castillo's story begins in a futuristic Casablanca in the year 2219.
Zoë tracks her missing ex-boyfriend Reza to Newport, where WatiCorp agents catch her and hook her up to a dreamer console that sends her into Arcadia.
A WatiCorp testing facility near Saint Petersburg is the source of the mysterious static.
Zoë flies to Japan to meet a WatiCorp insider who explains Project Alchera.

routes.name: Zoë Castillo
routes.note: Zoë follows her missing ex-boyfriend's trail from Casablanca to Newport, on to WatiCorp's secrets in Japan and a facility outside Saint Petersburg, then comes home to face the woman who made her.
